findings.description: As the man raises his hand along the side of his head, the reflection moves its hand across the center of the forehead and eyebrows, failing to match the direction and trajectory of the physical cause.
After lowering his hand from his hair, the man snaps back into the nearly static pose from 00:00 with minimal continuous motion for the remainder of the shot.
